sources.title: North Creek Butte Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: The 1934 build and 1952 abandonment are given by the Register, Firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb for North Creek Butte. Checked 2026-10-09: the cited WillhiteWeb page is the North Creek page (its captions name the North Creek Lookout sign), and the Register's North Creek page gives the same 1934 L-5 build and 1952 abandonment, so the dates hold for North Creek; the separate South Creek page was not used. No source describes current access, a visit route beyond a general map, or any remains; the access level is left out of facts for that reason. No staffing or fire history was found in the sources read. The photo captions on WillhiteWeb (1934 views) are not separately licensed or listed as new photos.
